description:
Wild Heart Episode 1 (Long Version)
Wild Heart Episode 2: https://youtu.be/jd1xer3IHco
(English Subtitles)

“Who are you protecting from whom?” said Yabani. “Are you protecting us from the streets, or the streets from us?”

Kidnapped from a well-established family at the age of just four and forced onto the streets, Ali returns home seventeen years later as Yaman. This is the story of a young man’s struggle to redefine himself as “Yaman Ali.”

Cast: Halit Özgür Sarı, Simay Barlas, Yurdaer Okur, Dolunay Soysert, Bertan Asllani, Tayanç Ayaydın, Sezer Arıçay, Rojbin Erden, Seray Özkan, İlayda Akdoğan, Güray Görkem

CREDITS
Producer: Fatih Aksoy & Mehmet Yiğit Alp
Production Company: NTC Medya
Director: M. Çağatay Tosun
Story/Screenplay: Yekta Torun
General Coordinator: Emel Kurt
Line Producer: Cenk Yengin
Music: Ender Gündüzlü
Genre: Drama
